BuiltInReportReadOnly.zh-TW: 內建報表不能修改，請另存一份
BuiltInReportReadOnly.en-US: Built-in reports cannot be changed. Save a copy instead
BuiltInReportReadOnly.th: แก้ไขรายงานในตัวไม่ได้ โปรดบันทึกเป็นสำเนา
BuiltInReportReadOnly.vi: Không thể sửa báo cáo có sẵn, hãy lưu một bản sao

BuiltInReportNoDelete.th: ลบรายงานในตัวไม่ได้
BuiltInReportNoDelete.vi: Không thể xóa báo cáo có sẵn

BuiltInReportNoShare.zh-TW: 內建報表人人都看得到，不需分享
BuiltInReportNoShare.en-US: Everyone can see built-in reports, so they don't need to be shared
BuiltInReportNoShare.th: ทุกคนเห็นรายงานในตัวอยู่แล้ว ไม่ต้องแชร์
BuiltInReportNoShare.vi: Mọi người đều xem được báo cáo có sẵn, không cần chia sẻ
